name: cemetery_recruitment_zombie_returns_and_draws_a_card
notes: Printed: 'Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. If it's a Zombie card, draw a card.' Seat 0's graveyard holds a Zombie card (the target) and a Bear card. The Zombie returns to hand and seat 0 draws exactly one card: its hand is the Zombie and the drawn card (2); the Bear stays in the graveyard. Seat 1 draws nothing.
